Require: Diffusion backbone with dual prediction  \( \{x_{\theta}, \epsilon_{\theta}\} \) , timesteps  \( \{t_{i}\}_{i=0}^{M} \) , initial noise  \( x_{t_{0}} \) , empty list  \( \ell \) , parameters  \( \phi \) 

1: Evaluate  \( \{\boldsymbol{x}_{\theta}(\boldsymbol{x}_{t_{0}}, t_{0}), \epsilon_{\theta}(\boldsymbol{x}_{t_{0}}, t_{0})\} \)  and add to  \( \ell \) 

2: for i = 0 to M - 1 do

3:  \( x'_{t_{i+1}} \leftarrow \text{Predictor}(x_{t_{i}}, \ell; \phi_{i}^{\text{pred}}) \) 

4: if i == M - 1 then break

5: Evaluate  \( \{\boldsymbol{x}_{\theta}(\boldsymbol{x}'_{t_{i+1}}, t_{i+1}), \epsilon_{\theta}(\boldsymbol{x}'_{t_{i+1}}, t_{i+1})\} \)  and add to  \( \ell \) 

6:  \( x_{t_{i+1}} \leftarrow \text{Corrector}(x_{t_{i}}, \ell; \phi_{i}^{\text{corr}}) \) 

7: end for

8: return  \( x'_{t_{M}} \) 

Require: Diffusion backbone with parameters  \( \theta \) , VAE decoder D, pretrained classifier C, solver S with parameters  \( \phi \) , label dataset Y, learning rate  \( \eta \) 

1: while not converged do

2: Sample  \( x_{T} \sim N(0, I) \)   \( \triangleright \)  initial noise

3: Sample  \( y \sim Y \)   \( \triangleright \)  class label

4:  \( x_{0} \leftarrow S(x_{T}; y, \phi, \theta) \)   \( \triangleright \)  sampling

5:  \( \hat{x}_{0} \leftarrow D(x_{0}) \)   \( \triangleright \)  decoding

6:  \( p \leftarrow C(\hat{x}_{0}) \)   \( \triangleright \)  class probabilities

7:  \( L \leftarrow CrossEntropy(p, y) \)   \( \triangleright \)  loss

8:  \( \phi \leftarrow \phi - \eta\nabla_{\phi}L \)   \( \triangleright \)  parameter update

9: end while
